note: Per-agent status is a dated snapshot and is mostly single-sourced: nearly all coverage after 1 September 2026 derives from one disclosure. Every row says so. Verify with your vendor.

manifold-disclosure.title: Manifold Security GitSpawn disclosure and 1 September 2026 retest, as reported by The Hacker News (2 Sep 2026). Later roundups repeat this table and are not counted as separate sources.

claude-code-changelog.title: Claude Code changelog v2.1.310 (23 Oct 2026), via a third-party mirror. Triage notes that quote the same changelog are the same origin.

hermes-agent-changelog.title: Hermes Agent changelog (v0.21.6 filter hardening, v0.22.x)

findings.path: core.fsmonitor read by git status / git diff probes
findings.detail: Confirmed vulnerable on 2.1.193; fixed by 2.1.196 per the 1 September retest.

findings.path: claude ultrareview (a different git configuration key; the key was withheld by the researchers)
findings.detail: Confirmed live on 2.1.252 at the 1 September retest. The 23 October changelog for 2.1.310 says ultrareview now requires workspace trust.
findings.caveat: UNVERIFIED: this rests on the vendor's changelog alone. No independent retest of the original finding was found. A changelog line is the vendor's claim, not a retest.

findings.path: repository-controlled git configuration read during routine git calls
findings.detail: Reported fixed as of the 1 September retest (CVE-2026-19592 for the CLI, CVE-2026-19593 for Desktop). The fixed-in version was not established.

findings.path: repository-supplied command run before the workspace-trust prompt
findings.detail: Reported 8 July 2026 and closed as a duplicate of an internal report; listed as patched at the 1 September retest. The fixed-in version was not established.

findings.path: goose review running git, reading core.fsmonitor

evidence.note: patch table; advisory quoted in coverage

findings.path: repository git configuration read by automatic git calls before the first prompt
findings.detail: Confirmed on 0.18.2 and 0.21.0 with the fix pending (CVE-2026-71963). A later release, 0.21.6, hardened git filter programs for a different private reporter; whether the original finding is closed was not established. Latest release seen: 0.22.5 (22 Oct 2026).
findings.caveat: UNVERIFIED: status after 1 September 2026 is not established by any independent retest.

context_evidence.note: v0.21.6 filter hardening, separate reporter; related, not the same finding

findings.detail: Confirmed on 0.19.6 and 0.22.3; accepted by the vendor's security response centre on 7 July 2026; no fix at the 1 September retest. No later fix was found, and a search that finds nothing is not evidence that nothing was released.
